effectEntries.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

descriptions.text: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
